#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

long long ways[61][61];

struct Half {
    long long match;
    long long value;
    Half(long long match, long long value) : match(match), value(value) {}

    bool operator<(const Half& o) const {
        return value < o.value;
    }
};

bool nextCombination(std::vector<int>& a, int n) {
    int k = (int) a.size();
    int ptr = k - 1;
    while (ptr >= 0 && a[ptr] == ptr - k + n) {
        --ptr;
    }
    if (ptr < 0) {
        return false;
    }
    a[ptr]++;
    for (int i = ptr + 1; i < k; i++) {
        a[i] = a[ptr] + i - ptr;
    }
    return true;
}

long long chooseFunc(int n, int k) {
    return (n >= 0 && k >= 0 && k <= n) ? ways[n][k] : 0;
}

long long getWins(const std::vector<char>& s, int r, int c) {
    int curA = 0, curB = 0;
    long long ret = 0;
    for (char cc : s) {
        if (cc == 'A') {
            ++curA;
        } else {
            ret += chooseFunc(curB, r - 1) * chooseFunc(curA, r);
            ++curB;
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

long long slow(int r, int c, const std::string& s) {
    std::vector<int> as(r + c);
    for (int i = 0; i < r + c; i++){
        as[i] = i;
    }
    long long totalWays = ways[r + c][r] * ways[r + c][c];

    std::vector<char> buf(2 * (r + c), 'B');

    long long bestDiff = LLONG_MAX;
    long long ans = 0;

    std::vector<std::string> good;

    do {
        std::fill(buf.begin(), buf.end(), 'B');
        for (int pos : as) {
            buf[pos] = 'A';
        }
        int match = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < 2 * (r + c); i++) {
            if (s[i] != '?' && s[i] != buf[i]) {
                match = 0;
                break;
            }
        }
        long long winsA = getWins(buf, r, c);
        long long diff = std::abs(2 * winsA - totalWays);
        if (diff < bestDiff) {
            bestDiff = diff;
            good.clear();
            if (match ==1) good.emplace_back(buf.begin(), buf.end());
            ans = match;
        } else if (diff == bestDiff) {
            ans += match;
            if (match == 1)
                good.emplace_back(buf.begin(), buf.end());
        }
    } while (nextCombination(as, 2 * (r + c)));
    return ans;
}

class F {
public:
    long long totalWays;
    long long bestDiff;
    long long ans;

    void submit() {
        int r = nextInt();
        int c = nextInt();
        std::string s = nextToken();
        std::cout << solve(r, c, s) << "\n";
    }

    long long update(const Half& a, const Half& b) {
        long long totalValue = a.value + b.value;
        long long diff = std::abs(2 * totalValue - totalWays);
        long long delta = a.match * b.match;
        if (diff < bestDiff) {
            bestDiff = diff;
            ans = delta;
        } else if (diff == bestDiff) {
            ans += delta;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    std::vector<Half> compress(std::vector<Half>& arr) {
        std::sort(arr.begin(), arr.end());
        int sz = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < (int)arr.size(); i++) {
            if (arr[i].value == arr[sz].value) {
                arr[sz].match += arr[i].match;
            } else {
                sz++;
                arr[sz] = arr[i];
            }
        }
        arr.resize(sz + 1);
        return arr;
    }

    long long solve(int r, int c, const std::string& s) {
        bestDiff = LLONG_MAX;
        ans = 0;

        uint64_t maskA = 0, maskB = 0;
        std::vector<std::array<int,2>> cnt(s.size() + 1);
        for (int i =0; i < (int)s.size(); i++) {
            cnt[i+1] = cnt[i];
            if (s[i] == 'A') {
                cnt[i+1][0]++;
                maskA |= 1ULL << i;
            }
            if (s[i] == 'B') {
                cnt[i+1][1]++;
                maskB |= 1ULL << i;
            }
        }

        uint64_t lastA = maskA >> (2 * r + c -1);
        uint64_t lastB = maskB >> (2 * r + c -1);

        std::vector<std::vector<Half>> fst(c + 2), snd(c + 2);
        std::vector<int> sz(c + 2);
        for (int i=0; i <= c+1; i++) {
            sz[i] = (int)ways[c+1][i];
            fst[i].resize(sz[i]);
            snd[i].resize(sz[i]);
        }

        for (int mask=0; mask < (1 << (c + 1)); mask++) {
            int btc = __builtin_popcount(mask);
            int compBtc = c + 1 - btc;
            int idx = --sz[btc];

            int samePref = std::min(
                __builtin_ctz((mask & 1) == 0 ? mask : (mask + 1)), c + 1);

            int totalA = r -1 - cnt[2 * r - 2 + samePref][0];
            int totalB = r -1 - cnt[2 * r - 2 + samePref][1];

            if ((mask & 1) == 0) {
                totalA += samePref;
            } else {
                totalB += samePref;
            }

            long long winsA = 0;
            int curA=0, curB=0;
            for (int i=0; i <= c; i++) {
                if (test(mask, i))
                {
                    winsA += ways[r -1 + curB][r -1] * chooseFunc(r -1 + curA, r);
                    curB++;
                } else {
                    curA++;
                }
            }

            int exactMatch=1;
            for (int i=samePref; i <= c; i++) {
                if ((!test(mask, i) && s[2*r - 2 + i] == 'B') || (test(mask, i) && s[2*r - 2 + i] == 'A')){
                    exactMatch=0;
                    break;
                }
            }
            {
                long long val=chooseFunc(totalA + totalB, totalA)*exactMatch;
                fst[btc][idx]= Half(val, winsA);
            }

            {
                int match=1;
                if (((~mask) & lastB) !=0) match=0;
                if ((mask & lastA)!=0) match=0;

                long long winsA =0;
                int curA=btc, curB=compBtc;
                for (int i=0; i <= c; i++) {
                    if (test(mask, i))
                    {
                        winsA += ways[r -1 + curB][r -1]* chooseFunc(r -1 + curA, r);
                        curB++;
                    } else {
                        curA++;
                    }
                }
                snd[btc][idx]= Half(match, winsA);
            }
        }

        totalWays = ways[r + c][r] * ways[r + c][r];
        long long halfTotal= totalWays / 2;

        for (int i=0; i <= c + 1; i++) {
            auto one=compress(fst[i]);
            auto two=compress(snd[c + 1 - i]);

            int ptr= two.size() -1;

            for (const auto &a: one) {
                while (ptr >=0 && a.value + two[ptr].value > halfTotal) --ptr;
                if (ptr >=0) update(a, two[ptr]);
                if (ptr +1< (int)two.size()) update(a, two[ptr+1]);
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    void run() {
        int r=nextInt();
        int c=nextInt();
        std::string s=nextToken();
        std::cout << solve(r,c,s) << "\n";
    }

    void init() {
        preCalc();
        submit();
    }

    long long preCalc() {
        for (int i=0; i <=60; i++){
            ways[i][0]=1;
            ways[i][i]=1;
            for (int j=1; j < i; j++){
                ways[i][j]=ways[i-1][j-1]+ways[i-1][j];
            }
        }
    }

    static bool test(int mask, int i) {
        return ((mask >> i) & 1)==1;
    }

    void preCalcWays() {
        // pre-calculated in constructor.
    }

    int nextInt() {
        if (!st || !hasMoreTokens) {
            std::string line;
            if (std::getline(std::cin, line)) {
                ss.clear();
                ss.str(line);
                hasMoreTokens=true;
            } else {
                throw std::runtime_error("EOF");
            }
        }
        int x;
        ss >> x;
        return x;
    }

    std::string nextToken() {
        if (!st || !hasMoreTokens) {
            std::string line;
            if (std::getline(std::cin, line)) {
                ss.clear();
                ss.str(line);
                hasMoreTokens=true;
            } else {
                throw std::runtime_error("EOF");
            }
        }
        std::string token;
        ss >> token;
        return token;
    }

private:
    std::istringstream ss;
    bool hasMoreTokens=false;
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    try{
        F solver;
        solver.run();
    } catch(...) {}
    return 0;
}
